role: The boundary the learner's reconstruction may not cross. Four blocks, all recovered verbatim from the project's own source transcript, none of which previously existed in this repository as a block.
why_this_register: Every other artifact authored during the 2026-09-26 repair is CANDIDATE_NOT_ADMITTED. This one cannot be, because a constitution that nothing may cite governs nothing. It still carries no promotion or truth authority: it constrains, it does not certify.
what_this_deliberately_is_not: It encodes NO cognitive semantics. No Generator, no Lateralizer mechanism, no Crystallizer algorithm, no planner.

The stated target is 'minimal noncognitive substrate + learner that progressively reconstructs the machinery it needs + deletes/reduces what becomes reconstructible'. Host-written cognitive machinery is the diagnosed error, not the goal.
Writing the operators as host machinery would repeat the #236 failure at larger scale. The specs stay recorded as candidates; the mechanisms stay unbuilt.
Constitutional boundary machinery is the exception, and deliberately so: 'constitutional boundary machinery = deliberately difficult / impossible for the learner to silently absorb or erase'.

block_a_permanent_noncollapse_laws.measurement_caveat: Coverage was measured with whitespace normalization. An earlier spaced-form grep reported 13 of 15 absent, which was wrong: the repository writes these without spaces around the operator. A presence check weaker than its name is the same defect class this file exists to prevent.
block_a_permanent_noncollapse_laws.equivalent_forms_note: The canonical statement and the tree's statement differ in punctuation only (slash versus underscore, EVENT versus EVENT/HISTORY). Declared explicitly rather than accepted by fuzzy match: a presence check that accepts near-misses silently is how a law drifts out of the tree without anyone noticing.

block_c_authority_graph.source: project source transcript, Canonical authority layer
block_c_authority_graph.axiom: NO FILE IS LIVE AUTHORITY BY LOCATION, RECENCY, NAME, OR SEMANTIC SIMILARITY. A file is live only because the live routing graph points to it with an explicit role.

defaults.Past/**: IMMUTABLE_EVIDENCE — never current merely because search found it
defaults.Future/**: UNADMITTED_FUTURE — never active merely because it exists
defaults.unclassified: fails closed to WITHHOLD before authority or mutation

past_prohibitions: MUST NOT silently establish current state
MUST NOT be edited into currentness
MUST NOT be copied back into live surfaces merely because it looks useful
block_c_authority_graph.future_prohibitions: presence in Future != scheduled != authorized != current != passed != dependency-active
block_c_authority_graph.why: Those names scream 'please assume I am the plan' to a language model.
block_c_authority_graph.live_coverage_before_this_file: zero. None of these class tokens appeared anywhere in the repository.
block_c_authority_graph.routing_note: Deliberately minimal. Only edges that are unambiguous from existing repository convention are declared. Everything else fails closed to WITHHOLD and is counted, not silently passed. Declaring the full routing graph is the branch author's call -- see CONST_G3 -- and an assistant inventing it would be the same overreach this file forbids.
block_c_authority_graph.withhold_baseline_note: 580 of 690 tracked paths are unrouted and therefore fail closed to WITHHOLD. This is a ratchet, not a target: the count may shrink as routing edges are declared, and the audit fails if it grows. It is recorded as a number rather than suppressed so that the size of the unrouted surface is visible in every run.

block_d_mutation_protocol.source: project source transcript, persisted mandatory form
control_surface: Forbidden move: solving developmental targets by adding capability-specific host machinery unless the repo contract explicitly requires a temporary scaffold and there is a removal test
Repository rule: audit before deletion; preserve provenance; never equate 'messy' with 'safe to remove'
Planning rule: one machine-readable roadmap DAG is authoritative; Markdown is projection, not state
Execution rule: every code change must point to a DAG node and state which invariant it advances
Stop condition: if a proposed change violates one of those invariants, I must not implement it just because it makes the immediate test pass
block_d_mutation_protocol.most_important_step: continue from state, not conversation memory
